reviews.title: This is a really good product
reviews.pros:
These are the pros I think this tool has. And I bet there are some more, but I will choose the most important ones:

- color palette

- font palette

- ruler

- design
reviews.cons:
No auto-layout.

No dark-mode/light-mode switch.

Small community.
reviews.overall: I would 100% recommend this product to every beginner UX designer who is looking for a free and useful tool for their products. I think it will be one of the top tools for UX designers.
